options.name: api_password
options.description: The password or token for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the E(ONE_PASSWORD) environment variable, if any, is used.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The ENDPOINT URL of the XMLRPC server. If not specified then the value of the E(ONE_URL) environment variable, if any, is used.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The name of the user for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the E(ONE_USERNAME) environment variable, if any, is used.

options.name: filter
options.description: V(user_primary_group) - Resources belonging to the user's primary group. V(user) - Resources belonging to the user. V(all) - All resources. V(user_groups) - Resources belonging to the user and any of his groups.

options.name: id
options.description: A O(id) of the template you would like to manage. If not set then a new template is created with the given O(name).

options.name: name
options.description: A O(name) of the template you would like to manage. If a template with the given name does not exist it is created, otherwise it is managed by this module.

options.name: state
options.description: V(present) - state that is used to manage the template. V(absent) - delete the template.

options.name: template
options.description: A string containing the template contents.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate the TLS/SSL certificates or not. This parameter is ignored if E(PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY) environment variable is used.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the desired state to be reached before timeout, in seconds.
